name: Curved furniture gives calm pleasure
claim: Rooms with curvilinear furniture gave more pleasure and more calm, relaxed feelings, and a stronger wish to enter, than rooms with rectilinear furniture.
caveat: Rendered rooms, not real ones; the furniture form can mix with other features of the scene; effect sizes were not seen.

sources.title: Dazkir and Read 2012, Furniture forms and their influence on our emotional responses toward interior environments, Environment and Behavior 44(5)
